{{Quote|He was a good man. May the Force be with him, wherever he is.|Airen Cracken on Startron|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Kevas Startron''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], the owner of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Sapphire's Gem|''New Cov Quasar'']] and a collaborator of [[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]] and [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].

==Biography==
Kevas Startron was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. At some point, Startron worked along with [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]], during the days of the Contruum resistance. Cracken respected Startron as a good man.

At some point circa [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], Startron wanted to retire, but decided to have one last run with his ship. Understanding that his health was not good, Startron recruited [[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]], a young smuggler woman with whom he was friends. Startron's health state then declined quickly and Sapphire was forced to pilot the ship on her own under challenging circumstances. Sapphire refused to take credit for her deeds, and instead people believed Startron was still in good shape. Grateful for her performance, Startron gave the ''Quasar'' to Sapphire as a gift; she renamed the ship ''[[Sapphire's Gem]]''. Startron then disappeared from the public eye, and even Airen Cracken's [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] resources could not keep track of him.
